name: OpenAI Models
label: OpenAI Models
description: Multimodal OpenAI LLM provider on the canonical v2 agent model-port contract (INPUT llm_input → OUTPUT llm_output). The handler reads {messages, tools, inputFiles?, stream?} from llm_input, merges instance configurationParameters, and calls OpenAI Chat Completions — or Images / TTS / STT when the selected model is in those families. Request-level inputFiles fold onto the last user message; generated files also surface as llm_output.outputFiles. Supports text plus image (vision) plus audio (input and output) plus PDF document blocks on chat models; image generation (gpt-image-2 current, gpt-image-1.5/gpt-image-1/gpt-image-1-mini; dall-e-3/dall-e-2 retired from the API on 2026-05-12 — kept for existing graphs); TTS (tts-1, tts-1-hd, gpt-4o-mini-tts); STT (whisper-1, gpt-4o-transcribe*). Reasoning models (o1*/o3*/o4*/gpt-5* with 'reasoning' in the id) are called on the Responses API (POST /v1/responses) with reasoning:{effort, summary:'auto'} + include:['reasoning.encrypted_content'] — Chat Completions never streams their reasoning, so this is what makes thinking deltas appear at all; a model the Responses endpoint refuses falls back to Chat Completions once (answer still streams, reasoning summaries stay unavailable there). Non-reasoning chat models stay on Chat Completions; sampling knobs are stripped and reasoning_effort/verbosity injected either way. Default model gpt-5.6-sol (gpt-5.6 alias also routes to Sol). When stream is true (default), the handler emits helper emitPartial("thinking", delta) for reasoning/thinking token deltas and emitPartial("answer", delta) for content deltas; thoughts also land on llm_output.result.thoughts and the legacy .thinking mirror; finish_reason, usage, and tool_calls are assembled after the stream ends. API key is a bound StudioQuack secret — never a literal in the graph JSON, never logged. templateId: 1c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b354. Purpose: the handler reads this field to drive OpenAI Models. Example: "sample". Data protection: prompts and context leave this host to OpenAI (https://openai.com/policies/row-terms-of-use). GDPR/data-processing notice: do not send personal data without a lawful basis and a provider DPA. Secrets belong only in configurationParameters and are never logged. Docs: https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models .
author: c525bb64-f52e-4829-8bf0-f1fe33aa6b42

ports.name: llm_input
ports.description: Canonical v2 LLM request — same wire format as Local LLM and the AI Agent model FUNCTION port so any of those nodes can connect unchanged. The handler reads getInputValuesByPortValue('llm_input'); if that list is empty it scans all inputs for an object whose value contains messages (v1 fallback). REQUIRED: missing/empty raises PROVIDER_ERROR 'No input received on \'llm_input\' port.'. Object shape: {messages, tools?, inputFiles?, stream?, streaming?, options?}. Per-call stream/streaming (top-level or options.stream) overrides the instance config pair. response_format and modalities are NOT in this payload — they are instance configurationParameters. Example: {"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"What is 2+2?"}],"tools":[]}. Purpose: the handler reads this field to drive llm_input. Accepted: type INPUT; omit to use default "llm_input".

schema.label: messages
schema.description: Conversation the OpenAI API must complete. Purpose: converted to OpenAI chat messages (multimodal files stay inside content blocks). Accepted value: list of {role, content, tool_calls?, thinking?, thoughts?, tool_call_id?, name?}. role: system | user | assistant | tool. content: string OR list of typed blocks {type:'text', text} | {type:'image'|'audio'|'video'|'document', mime_type, source:'base64'|'url'|'file_id', data, name?} | {type:'tool_use', id, name, input} | {type:'tool_result', tool_use_id, content}. Base64 data may include a data:<mime>;base64, prefix (stripped before send). Omit or [] is valid for STT/TTS/image families that derive the prompt from concatenated text. Non-list values are treated as []. Example: [{"role":"user","content":[{"type":"text","text":"Describe this."},{"type":"image","mime_type":"image/png","source":"base64","data":"iVBOR..."}]}].

schema.label: tools
schema.description: Tool definitions translated to OpenAI function-tools ({type:'function', function:{name, description, parameters}}). Purpose: enable tool_calls on chat models. Accepted value: list of {name, description, request:<JSON Schema>}. request.properties types are normalised (list→array, dict→object, int→integer, bool→boolean). Omit or [] → no tools on the API call. Ignored for image/TTS/STT model families. Example: [{"name":"get_weather","description":"Current weather for a city.","request":{"type":"object","properties":{"city":{"type":"string"}},"required":["city"]}}].

schema.label: inputFiles
schema.description: user-uploaded files and voice clips for the model.

children.label: kind
children.description: File kind. EXACT accepted values: image | document | audio | video.

children.label: mime_type
children.description: RFC 1521 media type, e.g. application/pdf, image/png.

children.label: source
children.description: Where data comes from. EXACT accepted values: base64 | url. Default: base64.

children.label: data
children.description: Base64-encoded payload (when source=base64) or absolute URL (when source=url).

children.label: name
children.description: Original filename, surfaced as the upload name.

ports.name: llm_output
ports.description: Canonical v2 LLM response envelope {result: <assistant payload>, outputFiles?: [...]} on success. Always one ResultItem on this port. outputFiles mirrors result.output_files when that list is non-empty and is omitted when empty. During streaming, thinking/answer deltas were already published via helper emitPartial; this object is the assembled end state. Example: {"result":{"role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"4"}],"finish_reason":"stop","usage":{"prompt_tokens":12,"completion_tokens":1,"total_tokens":13}}}. Purpose: the handler reads this field to drive llm_output. Accepted: type OUTPUT; omit to use default "llm_output". result is {role, content[], tool_calls?, thoughts?, thinking?, output_files?, finish_reason?, usage?}. Failures raise PROVIDER_ERROR (OpenAiChat.errorResponse / LlmAssistant.errorResponse). Secrets are redacted.

schema.label: result
schema.description: Assistant payload on success: {role:'assistant', content:[{type:'text', text:string}], tool_calls?:[{id, name, args, type:'tool_call'}], thoughts?:[{type:'thinking'|'reasoning_summary', text:string, signature?:string}], thinking?:[{type:'thinking', thinking:string}] (legacy mirror of thoughts for v1 agents), output_files?:[{type:'image'|'audio'|'document', mime_type, source:'base64', data, name?}] (image-gen / TTS / chat-audio), finish_reason?: 'stop'|'length'|'tool_calls'|'content_filter'|'error'|OpenAI-specific, usage?:{prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens, reasoning_tokens?}}. thoughts is filled from streamed reasoning summaries and/or usage.reasoning_tokens (e.g. {type:'reasoning_summary', text:'[Reasoning tokens used: 64]'}). When streaming, the same thinking text was also sent live as emitPartial("thinking", delta) and content as emitPartial("answer", delta); tool_calls/finish_reason/usage are only complete here at the end. Failures raise PROVIDER_ERROR (OpenAiChat.errorResponse) instead of an error envelope on this field. Never contains the raw api_key. Example success: {"role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"The order is packed."}],"thoughts":[{"type":"thinking","text":"Checking warehouse status…"}],"thinking":[{"type":"thinking","thinking":"Checking warehouse status…"}],"finish_reason":"stop","usage":{"prompt_tokens":80,"completion_tokens":12,"total_tokens":92}}. Purpose: the handler reads this field to drive result. Accepted: type object; omit to use default "".

children.label: role
children.description: Always 'assistant' on a completed turn.

children.label: content
children.description: Typed content blocks: {type:'text', text} plus media/tool blocks. The final answer text is the concatenation of text blocks.

children.label: tool_calls

children.label: thoughts
children.description: Reasoning trace entries {text} when the model exposes chain-of-thought.

children.label: thinking
children.description: Thinking blocks {type:'thinking', thinking} mirroring thoughts for UI rendering.

children.label: output_files
children.description: Generated files {kind, mime_type, source, data, name} (e.g. audio out).

children.label: kind
children.description: File kind. EXACT accepted values: image | document | audio | video.

children.label: mime_type
children.description: RFC 1521 media type, e.g. application/pdf, image/png.

children.label: source
children.description: Where data comes from. EXACT accepted values: base64 | url. Default: base64.

children.label: data
children.description: Base64-encoded payload (when source=base64) or absolute URL (when source=url).

children.label: name
children.description: Original filename, surfaced as the upload name.

children.label: kind

schema.label: streaming
schema.description: Live stream channel, present when the request sets stream/streaming true. While `result` assembles, the node emits deltas as {channel, delta} frames: channel 'thinking' carries reasoning/thinking deltas, channel 'answer' carries content deltas. A function-port caller (e.g. AI Agent model port) listens to this channel to render the stream live; the final assembled payload always arrives in `result`.

children.label: channel
children.description: Delta channel. EXACT values: thinking | answer.

children.label: delta
children.description: Incremental text piece for the channel. Append in arrival order.

configurationParameters.label: Model
configurationParameters.description: OpenAI model identifier sent as chat.completions/images/audio model=. Purpose: selects the API family and parameter whitelist. EXACT accepted values are the options[] list (gpt-5.6-sol, gpt-5.6-terra, gpt-5.6-luna, gpt-5.6, gpt-5.5, gpt-5.5-pro, gpt-5.5-mini, gpt-5.5-realtime, gpt-5.4, gpt-5.4-mini, gpt-5.4-nano, gpt-5.2, gpt-5.2-pro, gpt-5.1, gpt-5, gpt-5-pro, gpt-4.1, gpt-4.1-mini, gpt-4o, gpt-4o-mini, gpt-4o-audio-preview, gpt-4o-realtime-preview, gpt-4-turbo, gpt-4, o3, o3-pro, o3-mini, o4-mini, gpt-image-2, gpt-image-1.5, gpt-image-1, gpt-image-1-mini, dall-e-3, dall-e-2, whisper-1, gpt-4o-transcribe, gpt-4o-mini-transcribe, tts-1, tts-1-hd, gpt-4o-mini-tts). Chat/reasoning family: gpt-5.6-sol / gpt-5.6-terra / gpt-5.6-luna (current frontier; gpt-5.6 alias → Sol), previous gpt-5.5*/gpt-5.4*/gpt-5.2*/gpt-5.1/gpt-5*, gpt-4.1*, gpt-4o*, gpt-4*, o3*, o4*. Image generation: gpt-image-2 (current), gpt-image-1.5, gpt-image-1, gpt-image-1-mini; dall-e-3/dall-e-2 retired 2026-05-12 (kept so existing graphs still select). TTS: tts-1* / *-tts → output_files via audio.speech.create. STT: whisper-1 / *transcribe* → text via audio.transcriptions. Reasoning detection: id starts with o1/o3/o4/o- or contains 'reasoning' or starts with gpt-5 — sampling (temperature, top_p, penalties, logprobs, stop) is stripped; reasoning_effort + verbosity are injected. gpt-5* and computer-use* also strip stop. Empty/missing → PROVIDER_ERROR 'Missing model configuration.'. Default: 'gpt-5.6-sol'. Docs: https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models . Example: 'gpt-5.6-terra'.

configurationParameters.label: API Key
configurationParameters.description: OpenAI API key resolved just-in-time from a StudioQuack secret binding (never a committed literal). Purpose: authenticates the OpenAI SDK client. Accepted values: secret reference / password field; non-empty string after resolution. Empty/missing → PROVIDER_ERROR 'Missing api_key configuration.'. Obtain at platform.openai.com → Settings → API Keys; set billing limits first. NEVER log this value; it is added to the daemon redaction set. Example binding: $secretRef of an org secret named 'openai-prod'.

configurationParameters.label: Temperature
configurationParameters.description: Sampling temperature sent as temperature. Purpose: randomness of chat completions. Accepted values: number 0.0–2.0. Default: 1.0. Non-numeric is skipped. STRIPPED (not sent) for reasoning models (o1/o3/o4/o- prefixes or 'reasoning' in the id). Ignored for image/TTS/STT families. Example: 0.2.

configurationParameters.label: Top P
configurationParameters.description: Nucleus sampling sent as top_p. Purpose: keep the smallest token set with cumulative probability ≥ top_p. Accepted values: number 0.0–1.0. Default: 1.0. STRIPPED for reasoning models. Example: 0.9.

configurationParameters.label: Max Completion Tokens
configurationParameters.description: Hard cap on completion tokens (max_completion_tokens). Purpose: bound cost/latency. Replaces the deprecated max_tokens, which this node never sends. Accepted values: positive integers. Empty → omitted (OpenAI default). Example: 2048.

configurationParameters.label: Frequency Penalty
configurationParameters.description: Frequency penalty sent as frequency_penalty. Purpose: penalize repeated tokens by count. Accepted values: -2.0–2.0. Empty → omitted. STRIPPED for reasoning models. Example: 0.0.

configurationParameters.label: Presence Penalty
configurationParameters.description: Presence penalty sent as presence_penalty. Purpose: penalize tokens once they have appeared. Accepted values: -2.0–2.0. Empty → omitted. STRIPPED for reasoning models. Example: 0.0.

configurationParameters.label: Stop Sequences
configurationParameters.description: Stop sequences sent as stop. Purpose: halt generation when a sequence is emitted. Accepted values: comma-separated strings (split, trimmed, max 4) or a single string. STRIPPED for reasoning models and for ids starting with gpt-5 or computer-use. Empty → omitted. Example: 'END,\nUser:'.

configurationParameters.label: Completions Count
configurationParameters.description: Number of completions (n). Purpose: request multiple samples. Accepted values: positive integers. Default: 1. The handler still returns only the first choice on llm_output. For gpt-image-1, n is 1–10. Example: 1.

configurationParameters.label: Reasoning Effort
configurationParameters.description: Reasoning effort sent only for reasoning models (o1*/o3*/o4*/o- / ids containing 'reasoning', including gpt-5*). Purpose: trade hidden reasoning tokens vs. latency. EXACT accepted values: 'none' | 'minimal' | 'low' | 'medium' | 'high' | 'xhigh' | 'max'. GPT-5.6 supports none/low/medium/high/xhigh/max (default medium); 'minimal' is accepted for earlier gpt-5* families. Ignored on non-reasoning chat/image/TTS/STT models. Docs: https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/reasoning . Example: 'high'.

configurationParameters.label: Verbosity
configurationParameters.description: Reasoning verbosity sent only for reasoning models. Purpose: how much reasoning to surface. Accepted values: 'low' | 'medium' | 'high'. Empty → omitted. Example: 'low'.

configurationParameters.label: Response Format
configurationParameters.description: Chat Completions response_format (instance-level; the agent does not override per call). Purpose: force JSON or a schema. Accepted values: JSON object string (e.g. {"type":"json_object"} or a json_schema object); literal 'json' → {type:'json_object'}; literal 'text' → {type:'text'}. Default: 'text'. Invalid JSON that is not json/text is skipped. Not accepted on gpt-image-1 (always b64_json). Example: {"type":"json_object"}.

configurationParameters.label: Output Modalities
configurationParameters.description: Chat output modalities (instance-level). Purpose: request text and/or audio output on gpt-4o-audio-* models. Accepted values: comma-separated or JSON array; tokens filtered to 'text' and 'audio' (case-insensitive). Default: 'text'. Empty after filter → omitted. Presence of 'audio' (or a set audio config) forces streaming so audio deltas can be collected. Example: 'text,audio'.

configurationParameters.label: Audio Output Config
configurationParameters.description: JSON object for audio output when modalities includes audio. Purpose: voice and container. Accepted value: JSON object, e.g. {"voice":"alloy","format":"wav"}. Default: that object. Invalid JSON → omitted. Example: {"voice":"alloy","format":"wav"}.

configurationParameters.label: Parallel Tool Calls
configurationParameters.description: Allow multiple tool calls in one assistant turn. Purpose: sent as parallel_tool_calls=true only when this is true AND tools are present. Accepted values: boolean or true|1|yes. Default stored value 'false' means omit the field (OpenAI default). Example: true.

configurationParameters.label: Prompt Cache Key
configurationParameters.description: Stable string key used to bucket OpenAI prompt-prefix caches (prompt_cache_key). Purpose: reuse a long system prompt across calls. Accepted values: non-empty string. Empty → omitted. Example: 'support-agent-sys-v2'.

configurationParameters.label: Seed
configurationParameters.description: Best-effort determinism seed (seed). Purpose: reproduce a sample. Accepted values: integers. Empty/non-numeric → omitted. OpenAI does not guarantee bit-identical output. Example: 7.

configurationParameters.label: Service Tier
configurationParameters.description: OpenAI service_tier. Purpose: select latency/capacity class. EXACT accepted values: 'auto' | 'default' | 'flex' | 'priority' | 'fast'. Fast mode (renamed from Priority on 2026-07-30) is requested with 'fast' or 'priority' (GPT-5.6 and earlier responses still report 'priority'). Default: 'auto'. Empty string is not sent. Docs: https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/fast-mode . Example: 'fast'.

configurationParameters.label: Safety Identifier
configurationParameters.description: Optional identifier used by OpenAI safety classifiers to disambiguate end users (safety_identifier). Purpose: forwarded as a string. Accepted values: non-empty string. Empty → omitted. Do not put secrets or full PHI; use an opaque id. Example: 'enduser-42'.

configurationParameters.label: Stream
configurationParameters.description: Purpose: controls whether this provider requests a streamed completion and fans live deltas through helper emitPartial. Canonical flag. When true the node POSTs stream:true, parses SSE data: lines, emitPartial("thinking", delta) for reasoning/thinking and emitPartial("answer", delta) for content; thoughts also appear on llm_output.result.thoughts / thinking; finish_reason, usage and tool_calls are assembled at the end. Accepted: select true | false. Input-port stream/streaming overrides this config. Default: true. Invalid/blank → true. Example: true.
